VERIFICATION FIXES (this commit): (1) A9 settled by the PLAN ruling above and the re-pointed tag. (2) exitWing(here, wing) takes the wing being exited and returns back only when history.state is in-app and on that wing (EXPERIENCE §3.4); routes.test.ts row 9b covers a mismatched wing and a main-track entry. (3) defineExhibit checks import.meta.env?.DEV !== false: assertions run in dev, vitest and under tsx or plain Node (the old code threw 'TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading DEV)' under tsx), and a production Vite build folds the check away (scratch build: defineExhibit compiles to an identity function). (4) StatsProbe exports markExhibitMounted(id) returning a disposer; stats().mounted lists marked or reported exhibits in EXHIBIT_IDS order, so placeholders and compiling exhibits count, and the disposer drops the exhibit's stats on unmount. Smoke page in headless Chromium 141 (SwiftShader): two placeholder frames plus one revealed frame gave mounted [verafin, cfia, mun] before ready, exhibits only verafin, and mounted [] with exhibits {} after unmounting all three without calling reportExhibit(id, null); no page errors. (5) layout.test.ts asserts computeLayout throws for zero or two education entries; the schema keeps min(1) per ARCHITECTURE §3.3 and the PLAN ruling has WP-03's check-content run computeLayout after the parse. (6) tokens.ts header now says WP-05 adds tokens.css. (7) This report ships in the last fix commit, as _TEMPLATE.md asks; the earlier report-only commit 6ef8e7a is accepted by the ruling.
RESOLVED BY R0 (PLAN Addendum, R0 rulings after WP-02 verification): A9 waiver and tag target; query strings survive every history write and e2e specs assert on the pathname; one education entry in v1 enforced by computeLayout and run by check-content; stats().mounted convention (ExhibitFrame calls useEffect(() => markExhibitMounted(id), [id]) and reportExhibit after reveal); reportCameraTarget accepted for WP-09's CameraRig.
